ca.compare: Check that the device said the same groups before you trust this certificate:
ca.help_android: Android: Settings › Security › Encryption & credentials › Install a certificate › CA certificate.
ca.help_ios: iPhone or iPad: open the downloaded profile in Settings, install it, then turn it on under General › About › Certificate Trust Settings.
ca.help_linux: Linux: add it to your browser's certificate authorities (Firefox: Settings › Privacy & Security › Certificates).
ca.help_macos: Mac: open it in Keychain Access, then set it to Always Trust.
ca.help_windows: Windows: open it, choose Install Certificate, and place it in Trusted Root Certification Authorities.

onboarding.account_help: You'll be the admin of this house.
onboarding.home_critical: Locks, garage doors and alarms always go to adults only. You can change any of this later.
onboarding.home_recommended: Let everyone in the house use lights, switches, media and climate in every room (recommended)

onboarding.kit_help: Print or write down these codes. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone.
onboarding.llm_help: I use Amazon Bedrock to answer anything beyond lights, timers and lists. You can skip this: the fast path works offline.
onboarding.practice_help: Add this page to your home screen. Then try a practice approval so the first real one isn't a surprise.
onboarding.recover: Sign in with a recovery code
onboarding.recover_help: This device is already set up. An admin recovery code signs that admin in.

onboarding.voice_help: Stand near beepboop and tap Start. It takes about two minutes, and no recording is kept.

privacy.delete_transcripts_body: The words of every turn go. What each turn did stays in Activity.

privacy.nothing_left: Nothing left this house for you in the last 30 days.
